text:
maria: FYI the quarterly least-priv sweep flagged ~120 admin principals with either no owner or stale owners. Thinking we should carve out a safe triage flow before we start mass notifications.

sam: Agree. We saw a few false positives last time when cross-account KMS keys looked ownerless. Any plan to avoid that?

maria: Plan sketch: (1) enrich inventory with key_owner_account + last_credential_issue_ts; (2) run a risk classifier to rank; (3) whitelist tags and a kms-exempt table; (4) produce audit blobs for any action.

hugo: +1. For (1) I can add key_owner_account and token_issue_ts to the nightly export. Will also include a boolean 'used_in_pipeline' if the principal appears in task-scheduler logs.

auditbot: ran a test pass on staging. sample hit: {principal: "svc-ml-trainer", role: "project-admin", owner: null, last_active_days: 412, kms_bound: true, key_owner_account: "ext-analytics-123"}

sam: That one is almost certainly cross-account. We need an exceptions join so it doesn't show up as ownerless. Hugo's key_owner_account field solves that.

maria: Triage priority idea: "Critical" = admin && (owner==null || last_active_days>365) && kms_bound -> manual review within 24h; "High" = admin && owner==null -> auto-notify infra leads with 72h SLA; "Medium" = owner present but inactive 90-365d -> owner ping + 14d; "Low" = <90d -> include in weekly digest.

hugo: Safety checks: never auto-revoke kms bindings; require two approvers for admin removals; snapshot policy blob + exact IAM binding to audit GCS with 180d retention. Also include a repro script that reapplies the binding.

sam: Can we add a quick risk score to sort the queue? Something like: base = is_admin?60:15; + (owner==null?25:0); + min(last_active_days,365)/6; + (kms_bound?35:0) - recent_incidents*8. That should surface the worst first.

maria: Good. Action items: hugo -> augment nightly export with key_owner_account, token_issue_ts, used_in_pipeline tag (due Mon). sam -> implement scoring and canary notifier that posts a candidate CSV to #eng-security-results (due Tue). maria -> draft the audit evidence schema and submit runbook PR (due Tue EOD).

hugo: Also, note that long-running batch jobs rotate tokens weekly; use last_token_issue to avoid false positives. I'll add that flag.

auditbot: scheduled job least-priv-sweep will run Sun 02:00 UTC and attach CSV to #eng-security-results.

maria: Thanks. I'll draft the PR tomorrow and include examples of 'safe exemptions' and the appeal flow. React with :thumbsup: when you review.
